overview_description: List, read, create, update, enable, disable and delete the user roles on an Exsited instance.
intro: Roles are the settings records that group user permissions, and each says whether it is a system role. You can list, read, create, update, enable or disable and delete roles. This area has 5 endpoints, and all seven SDKs call every one.
warning: **A create or an update saves the role and then returns a `500`, so check the roles listing before you retry.**
notes: **Responses wrap a role in `role`.** A single read returns `{"role": {...}}`.
**`is_system_role` marks the built in roles.** A delete of a system role is refused.
**A create or an update reports an error after it saves.** The change is stored even though the status is `500`, so list the roles to find the record.
**Listings page by cursor.** Pass `limit` for the page size, then pass `pagination.next_cursor` back as `cursor` while `pagination.has_more` is true.

endpoints.title: List roles
endpoints.summary: Returns a page of roles under `data`, with paging details under `pagination`.
endpoints.description: Lists the roles on the instance, each with an `is_system_role` flag. Pass `limit` to set the page size, and while `pagination.has_more` is true pass `pagination.next_cursor` back as `cursor` to read the next page. Other fields filter as `filter_<field>` or `filter_<field>_<operator>`, and `sort` orders the results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `pagination.next_cursor` of the previous page, to read the next one.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

endpoints.title: Create a role
endpoints.summary: Creates a role. The role is saved, but the call then returns a `500`.
endpoints.description: Send the new role under `role`. The role is saved, and the call then returns a `500` from a failed lookup after the save, so list the roles to find it before you retry.

500.description: The role is saved, and the lookup that follows the save fails.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a role
endpoints.summary: Returns one role by its `id`, under `role`.
endpoints.description: Reads the role with this `id`. The `id` is the one the listing returns.

parameters.name: role_id
parameters.description: The role's `id`, as the listing returns it.

endpoints.title: Delete a role
endpoints.summary: Deletes a role. A system role is refused.
endpoints.description: Deletes the role with this `id`. A role whose `is_system_role` is true cannot be deleted.

parameters.name: role_id
parameters.description: The role's `id`, as the listing returns it.

204.description: The role is deleted. The response has no body.

endpoints.title: Update a role
endpoints.summary: Changes a role, or enables or disables it. The change is saved, but the call then returns a `500`.
endpoints.description: Send the fields to change under `role`, or its `status` to enable or disable it. The change is saved, and the call then returns a `500` from a failed lookup after the save, so read the role again to see the result.

parameters.name: role_id
parameters.description: The role's `id`, as the listing returns it.

500.description: The change is saved, and the lookup that follows the save fails.

created_by.description: Null in every record read so far, so its type is not known.

description.description: Null in every record read so far, so its type is not known.

last_updated_by.description: Null in every record read so far, so its type is not known.

limit.description: The page size applied to this page.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows. Trust this over `next_cursor`, which can still be set on the last page.

next_cursor.description: Pass this back as `cursor` to read the next page.
